mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner ear’s sensing tissue was most worthwhile: it showed how moving fluid bends tiny hairs and changes nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the hearing pathways was less engaging because the ears were still only outlines; it felt like a necessary setup step.

surprise.text: I wasn’t sure how movement reached the hearing cells’ hairs until the fluid and bending-hair picture explained it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary, though connecting the hearing pathways to the body before fitting the ears was mostly following the available pairing.

continue.text: Yes, I’d try another chapter: following vibrations into nerve signals was clear and satisfying, though the final connections were fairly predictable.
